independentExperimentalUnit: One fresh private/temporary browser conversation per batch; six tasks share one context and are correlated. No six-task independent sample claim.

models.gemini: Google Gemini browser UI, Flash mode; exact backend revision unavailable
models.grok: Grok in X browser UI, Fast mode; exact backend revision unavailable

memory.meaning: Note and DXP derive from identical frozen repository and actual validated contextPacket. Note repeats prose already present in evidence. No-memory deliberately omits experiences only.
memory.operation: Coordinator calls actual DXP validator/contextPacket; note contains same complete facts; consumer receives serialized material. No interactive retrieval operations.

limitations: P01-P06 publicly disclosed; not held out
Provider identities observed through UI; weights and backend versions unattested
No claim that browser private mode removes every provider-side personalization influence
Six tasks in one batch; no task-level independent inference or confidence interval
Costs/tokens unavailable; elapsed observation includes browser latency
Presentation diagnostic only; cannot establish versioning operation utility or replace 384-run weekly matrix
Same known tasks reused after transport diagnosis; new contexts do not establish no provider-side caching or personalization.
v1 archived independently; v2 is an explicit development protocol revision, not a repaired historical score.
successCriterion: Each task artifact passes its unchanged acceptance and common regressions. Record missing cells, invalid edits, errors and all raw visible responses. No manual repair of model output.

transportGate.input: Single-line serialized JSON; verify exact editor text before submit, allowing only surrounding editor newlines.
transportGate.output: One visible fenced code block extracted as pre/code textContent; JSON parsed without repair.
transportGate.calibration: Both providers passed exact echo of underscores, operators and escapes before v2 freeze.
